text: 美非农就业意外疲软，打击美联储加息预期，上周五标普500、道指齐创收盘新高，纳指收涨超1%；全周美油跌近8%、期金涨超7%。 美国7月非农就业人数意外不增反减2.3万，前两月就业下修10.3万人，7月失业率降至逾一年低位4.1%。 伊朗、阿曼仍未就重新开放霍尔木兹海峡达成最终协议；伊朗拒绝与美国直接谈判；特朗普称正在“低调处理”伊朗问题，更倾向于加大经济施压。 美参议院通过临时拨款法案，暂缓政府“停摆”风险。 中国7月CPI同比涨幅收窄至0.5%，PPI同比上涨3.5%，AI驱动平板电脑价格环比上涨11.3%。 中国央行连续21个月增持黄金，7月购金力度
text_en: US nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly weak, dampening Fed hike expectations; last Friday S&P 500 and Dow both closed at record highs, Nasdaq rose over 1%; for the week, WTI crude fell nearly 8%, gold futures rose over 7%. US July nonfarm payrolls unexpectedly fell by 23,000, prior two months revised down by 103,000, July unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, a one-year low. Iran and Oman still have not reached a final agreement on reopening the Strait of Hormuz; Iran refuses direct talks with the US; Trump says he is handling the Iran issue 'low-key,' preferring to increase economic pressure. US Senate passed a temporary funding bill, easing government shutdown risks. China's July CPI rose 0.5% year-on-year, narrowing, PPI rose 3.5% year-on-year, AI-driven tablet prices rose 11.3% month-on-month.
